about: HM-11 (multi-profile plan 6; contract 3, 4.1): every management call the panel makes once a product is switched on, and every refusal it handles, as one list of cases.

tests/test_panel_profile_api_shapes.py runs every case against the real 8099 management app (in process, the switch monkeypatched on) and tests/browser/profile-api-parity.spec.mjs against the LOCAL MOCK (fixtures/server.mjs); both must observe exactly the expect of every case. So the mock answers as the add-on does: status, field names and types, the echo, the ETag.

A request: method, path ({B} an id of rules.ids or a learnt one, {key:CASE} the Idempotency-Key a case sent), profile (X-MCP-Profile: a role, a literal, or none), csrf (a fresh one), if_match (index: the list's ETag; raw: the default bootstrap's profile_index_etag; config:R: profile R's configuration revision; stale-index, stale-config: well formed, never current), key (new, or same:CASE), body (JSON).

What is compared: the status, the class of the ETag header (p1, c1, other or null), the body as rules say (keys: every top-level key, or only the listed ones that are present). Strings are compared by value for the rules.literal keys; ids by role (default, a rules.ids name, a learnt name, <hex24>); an Idempotency-Key of a case as <key:CASE>; ETags and revisions by class; anything else as <str>. Numbers are <int>, booleans and null as they are. A body that is not JSON is <empty> or <text>.

HM-12 (DQ-05, DQ-40 ⑨ (a); contract 3.1, 4.1, section 9 #113-#115): a backend save of a switched-on Odoo profile as the panel sends it, and the answers the panel handles: token_rotated (200, and shape D when the new child does not start), the new-origin 422 and the two 503s. setup.backend_edit: the mock serves backend_edit (the add-on always does). An extra's connection: its saved url, database and username (the add-on saves the golden connection with the profile's name; the Python test requires these values). setup.fault: one failure of the identity change, armed on B as tests/test_odoo_identity_rotation.py arms it (stop: the old child does not stop; write: the store refuses the write; start: the new child does not start).

HM-13c: a restore (setup restore: the entrypoint's marker before the start; policy: the default profile's policy before any profile is made, which the others copy; quarantine: orphans whose writer lock is gone, which the boot guard quarantines). A list case may learn its first quarantine directory's name (learn_quarantine: a role for {ROLE} in a path).

HM-27 (DQ-11 (a); contract 2.6, 3.1, 3.5, 4.1): the add-on's one Origin policy of the secret path, GET and PUT {base}/api/origin-policy (a global path: X-MCP-Profile never read, no echo), as the panel reads and saves it: If-Match origin (the ETag the last GET answered; o1-), stale-origin, an Idempotency-Key and its receipt beside the policy, the refusals the panel handles (origin_policy_invalid 422). setup.origin_policy unusable: a policy file the add-on cannot use (the mock: originUnusable). Headscale has no policy (its own rule): an unknown operation.

HM-25 (HM-12 review S-6, handed over by the HM-12 panel slice): n8n's saved connection, in the admin API's names (setup extras connection: its url; its key and MCP access token are secrets, never shown). A scenario with rerecord_on_real_backend true was recorded against the real 8099 app with mock children only (tests/test_panel_profile_api_shapes.py, in process): its expect is to be recorded again on a real backend (n8n's HAOS acceptance) before the product is switched on, and changed here if the add-on answers otherwise there.
